verdict.rationale: Granola documents pre-meeting briefs, prepared overnight, that show open threads, relevant context and agenda points when you open the note as you join. Calendar sync supplies the upcoming meetings. The evidence never says the brief surfaces past meetings with the same attendees; 'relevant context' only implies it. missing for 10: explicit documentation that past meetings with the same participants are surfaced before the call, detail on how brief content is sourced, independent or hands-on corroboration of brief quality.

support.subject: As a founder, I walk into each meeting prepped — the tool surfaces past meetings with the same people and a brief of open threads before the call

citations.quote: Granola preps you for your meetings overnight. Open your note as you join and you'll see a short brief with open threads, relevant context, and agenda points
Open your note as you join and you'll see a short brief with open threads, relevant context, and agenda points so you walk in ready.
See upcoming meetings, create notes from events, and get meeting context.
